research_direction: The one axis my earlier attempts never varied: the SFT dose. Across three prior submissions the narrow SFT install measured only +0.085 on-slice, so a live explanation for the null was that there was too little installed behaviour for a midtrain prior to generalize. This raises the planted share of the SFT stage from 3.16% to 12.2% of tokens (685 -> 2,800 rows), holding the midtrain stage, the reference cell, the token budget, the update count and the eval fixed, and runs BOTH doses at TWO training seeds. The submitted 2x2 is the high-dose arm at the first seed (20260804), fixed by seed order and not by outcome.

cells.R: clean Dolmino midtrain -> clean Dolci SFT (reference; a real trained cell)
cells.M: live-mix midtrain (Corvane explanatory docs) -> clean Dolci SFT
cells.S: clean Dolmino midtrain -> mixed SFT at 12.2% planted
cells.T: live-mix midtrain -> mixed SFT at 12.2% planted

base_model_arm: reported for context only; never used as the reference cell
backend: scimt.train hf backend (single GPU, full parameter, no FSDP)
gate1_selfcheck: passed locally with the pod's floors and tolerance
